name: Sunrise Izumo and Sunrise Seto sleeper trains
intro: Japan's last regular overnight sleeper trains, leaving Tokyo at night and arriving in Izumo or Takamatsu the next morning. Each train has only a limited number of private rooms, and they often sell out within minutes of the 10:00 release.

facts.bookAhead: One month: berths open at 10:00 on the same date a month before

statusNote: The standard JR release rule, read from JR-WEST's official English page.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: a well-known "bucket list" train with a small, dedicated audience.
difficultyNote: Rail guides and travellers report the private rooms selling out within minutes of the 10:00 release.
bookingSteps: Book on JR-WEST Online Train Reservation, which is in English.
Be ready a few minutes before 10:00 Japan time, one month before your travel date. The private rooms often go within minutes.
Pay by credit card when you book.
Before boarding, collect your ticket at a ticket machine: choose "Receive reserved ticket", insert the card you paid with and enter your four-digit ID number.
Starting in Tokyo? JR East has only a few machines and Travel Service Centers that hand out these tickets, so find one in advance.
visitorTips: If you board without collecting your ticket, you must buy a new one at full price.
Bring the physical card you paid with. Virtual cards can't be used to collect tickets.
If the same date doesn't exist in the previous month, sales start on the 1st of the travel month.

soldOut.label: Take the Shinkansen instead: same 10:00 release

faq.q: When can I book the Sunrise Izumo?
faq.a: At 10:00 Japan time, one month before your travel date, on JR-WEST Online Train Reservation.

sources.quote: starting at 10:00 am (JST) on same day of preceding month.
A passport with an IC chip is required for this.
